item.title: Let's say if SCP was real, which department would you choose?: Let's say if SCP was real, which department would you choose?
item.content:encoded:
There are different SCP foundation departments and if you don't know them, these are the departments of the SCP foundation. Now, let's say, in an alternate universe, SCP DID exist and you had the option to choose to be one of the departments. Which one would YOU choose? Would you choose to test SCPs? Would you like to manage the SCP foundation? Would you like to secure the facility? Or would you like to contain SCPs? You choose down in the comments.

In my opinion, I would choose to be a AD

item.title: Ask The Person Above You A Question (PART IX): Re: @Luxkeeper
item.content:encoded: There are already some Indo-European-language-based constructed languages, like Esperanto, Interlingua and even a plan of simplified English. Would they be probable choices for you?

item.title: What are your two favorite articles on the SCP wiki?: Re: What are your two favorite articles on the SCP wiki?
item.content:encoded:
SCP-2806 is my number one, and I am also intrigued by SCP-2878 coming at the same concept from the opposite angle.

I'd also like to take this opportunity to say I like SCP-777-J and SCP-10101-J even though they are jokes and are supposed to be examples of bad writing, I totally get that BUT…can somebody please animate their fight?!

item.title: Ask The Person Above You A Question (PART IX): Re: @Luxkeeper
item.content:encoded:
Well I would really like to refine or make a new language under the basis of the Indo-European family like English (American/British), mostly because its a common secondary language.

I wouldn't really pick mandarin considering the… Many Characters and its complexity.

Well considering the world has a whole lot of languages, best course would be to invest in a translation device in aiding the effort of implement such unifying language.

item.title: Ask The Person Above You A Question (PART IX): @Luxkeeper
item.content:encoded: Suddenly aliens appear on our telescopes, and start communicating with us. The nature of their communications makes it clear that Earth must present a united front, to show we are ready to advance into the space age. Part of the unification effort is making everyone speak one language, and you are the head of the committee deciding which language that will be. What language do you choose, and why?

item.title: Help: Re: Help
item.content:encoded:
What page where you trying to make? If you were logged in, there's a decent chance it was cos it was at e.g. http://www.scpwiki.com/protected:scp-5123 say (and in the 'protected' category as a result): you'll want to make a page without a colon in the url.

There's a possibility you were logged out due to a wikidot bug: the extension here would help you fix this.

(Also as a sidenote note, getting feedback before posting is highly recommended: the How to Write An SCP guide covers how you can do this)
